decisions.decision: Member removal: user-scoped owner-only delete_member_recipes RPC first (deletes only reviewed ids the member created, in the owner's cookbook), then service-role deleteUser, which cascades the membership, nulls recipe creators and invites.used_by, and frees the email
removeMember(input, deps?) has no caller-id parameter; the caller is the injected client's own session via getMembershipStatus(client); removeMemberAction passes no deps

getMembershipStatus: AuthRetryableFetchError (status 0, 500, 503) or any membership-query error -> unavailable; AuthSessionMissingError and deleted users -> none; getMembershipStatus() without a client is cached per request
git.allow_default_branch_commits: true in .planning/config.json; plan commits stay on main
